observed_finding: At this early C24 checkpoint the complete evidence branch is active, but replacing regional descriptors with their within-case coordinate means barely changes predictions on these two fitting cases.
decision: Continue the predeclared matched B/C/C0 and separate C100 objective-scale experiment. Require actual pilot acceptance before any full C100 launch. Inspect fixed-final evidence sensitivity alongside outcomes; do not infer a correction from gradient magnitude alone.
limitations: Only original fitting ordinals0/1 and step24; not independent validation.
The intervention preserves case means and all context-derived mu/delta/a, so it does not remove every MRI signal.
Mean replacement changes regional and acquisition variation together; it is not a pathology-localization test.
Marginal descriptor variances and residual MSE across correlated regions/classes do not estimate correct conditional covariance.
Likelihood-scale derivative is local sensitivity, not a direction of accuracy improvement.
Support terms add before marginalization; mixture logBF contributions are not additive.
